name: FSE Lifestyle Services Limited
summary: FSE Lifestyle Services Limited, an investment holding company, provides engineering and consultancy services in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and Macau. It operates through Property Asset Management, Supporting Services, and E&M Engineering segments. The company offers property management, sales, and leasing; facility management; property agency services; car park management; and asset management advisory services.
